claim_boundary.allowed: bounded same-action level/model associations for this implementation, subgroup, exact sampled models, generator construction, hash behavior, and accounting interval; not a causal conductor effect

inference.causal_boundary: Same-action association among the fixed sampled crater/floor models only; curve/model choice, generator construction, and hash behavior remain bundled, so this does not isolate a causal conductor effect.
inference.estimand: log2(arithmetic mean numerator walk_ops / arithmetic mean denominator walk_ops)
inference.hierarchical_sensitivity_bootstrap: paired two-stage percentile bootstrap sensitivity: resample 16 floor-orbit strata with replacement, then paired inferential target blocks within each selected stratum; this targets a modeled orbit superpopulation, not the exact sampled-orbit census
inference.primary_bootstrap: primary paired fixed-orbit stratified percentile bootstrap: retain all 16 sampled floor-orbit strata exactly once and independently resample 192 paired inferential target blocks within each stratum

unmeasured_exclusions: final scalar recovery multiplication and certificate verification
field-primitive weights converting squarings, comparisons, and sign operations to group-addition equivalents
